rand3.description: uniform random 3-SAT at the threshold (CNFgen randkcnf; as v8)

col3.description: graph 3-coloring of uniform G(n, m), m = round(2.3 n), graph sampled with random.Random(seed), CNFgen kcolor on the DIMACS graph (as v8)

assign2.description: coupled task assignment (v9): T tasks, R resources, each task allowed a random list of L resources; exactly one resource per task; per-resource capacity at most ceil(slack*T/R) and optionally at least floor(T/R) - lower_gap; conflicting tasks (random G(T, round(c*T))) never share a resource. PySAT CardEnc sequential counter. One structure is chosen in the pilot (protocol section 2).
assign2.structures_note: A-C pre-registered (protocol section 2.1); D-F added after pilot round 1 (deviation 2) because A-C were trivial at T <= 200; grid extended between 400 and 800

generators_v11.note: Secondary parameters of the v11 families (scripts/broad_scope_v11/families.py). Values here are the pre-exploration defaults; the exploration stage (protocol section 4.1) may replace each by one value of its registered grid, chosen from D cost / search coverage only, before the pilot.

jssp.grid_note: deviation 2: beta {1.0,1.1,1.2} -> {1.3,1.45,1.6}; deviation 3: fixed multiples of LB are trivial at both ends (<= 1.2 all refuted by propagation, >= 1.3 all solved in <= 0.05 s), so the horizon is T = max(LB, floor(rho UB)) with UB the best of three dispatch-rule schedules, rho in {0.85, 0.9, 0.95}; sizes explored n = 8/10/12/15
